resources.string: Android does not allow selecting storage roots, Download, Android/data, or Android/obb through folder authorization.
To mount the Termux home folder, select Termux in the system folder picker.
Storage paths require All files access. Private app folders and system directories are unavailable.
All files access is not granted.
Unavailable. Check the storage device or authorize the folder again.
Source files stay in place. Folder authorization is released when no other mount uses it.
Deleted copies are kept for 7 days, up to 32 MiB and 100 items. Restore returns them to their source folder. Deletion is refused when space is insufficient.
Unable to load this folder. Check its authorization or storage device, then retry.
The operation failed. Check the mount, its permissions, and the entered values.
The source file has changed since it was imported to the Library. Import it again to update the index.
Library imports use a snapshot. Source changes are not synchronized automatically.
Text preview is unavailable for this file type. Open a read-only copy in another app.
Text preview supports files up to 256 KB. You can import a snapshot or open a read-only copy.
Unable to preview this file. Check its authorization or storage device.
Opening a read-only copy supports files up to 8 MB.
Unable to open this file. A compatible app may not be installed.
File restored to its source folder.
After you add a folder, the Agent can work with its files at /mnt/alias/.
Choose a folder in the system picker, including app folders such as Termux
Enter a storage path. Requires All files access
Restore files the Agent deleted from mounted folders
Only file tools can see this folder. Commands cannot reach folders authorized through the system picker.
File tools use /mnt/alias/. Commands reach it by its real path, and in Workspace mode each command still asks first.
